subject: Mathematics
title: Relations and Functions: Chapter Introduction
summary: Roll numbers and birthdays are both functions, but only roll numbers are one-one. The chapter classifies relations and functions and shows which functions can be reversed.
keyPoints: A **relation** from A to B is any set of pairs (a subset of A × B); a **function** gives each input exactly one output.
**One-one**: different inputs give different outputs (roll numbers). Birthdays are a function but **many-one**.
**Onto**: every element of B is an output. **Bijective** = one-one + onto; only bijective functions have an **inverse**.
A relation that is **reflexive, symmetric and transitive** is an **equivalence relation** ("is in the same class as").
